about: Look invariants: one entry per flaw the owner reported, each a view (q, a still: speed=0 is added) with absolute measures and limits (tools/lib/measures.mjs). Fields: reported (the date), wrong (what was wrong, in one line), measures (each: measure, region [x, y, w, h] as fractions of the picture, its options, and min and/or max), bad and fixed (commits where it was bad and where it was fixed: the proof), sweep ({param, values}: one still for each value of that parameter of the page, measured together by the sweep measures), expected ('fail': a known open flaw; it is reported as KNOWN, and passing fails the run so that the mark is removed), reference (values measured on other commits, for reading only). The stills are of size (unless --size; the limits hold at this size). A limit changes only on purpose, in a commit that says why.

entries.name: night-full-moon-8.9km
entries.wrong: a night under a full moon as bright as deep dusk
entries.note: Limits from the eye under a full moon: the scene's median (some 0.013 cd/m2) comes out at about 16 to 23 with Ward's contrast scale factor (1994; a display adapted to 50 cd/m2), and Kirk and O'Brien (2011) map low light into a quarter to a half of the display's range; the moonlit tops stay in sight (p95 of the lower part at least 24). f605245: p50 31.2, p95 53.8; the fix: 18.6, 32.9.
